title: MarshalJournalEntry
description: One journal line's shape (Story 3.1, AD-28/AD-30): {id, ts, run_id, story?, kind, phase, intent_id?, payload}. additionalProperties is false at both the document and the entryId level, matching gate-record.json's/policy.json's own closed-schema discipline. id/intent_id are structured {writer_id, counter} objects, never a delimited string -- the composite nature AD-28 describes is literal in the shape. The allOf below enforces AD-28's mandatory-on-outcome, absent-otherwise intent_id rule -- the same invariant core.journal.JournalEntry.__post_init__ enforces on the producing side. This schema describes one already-serialized JSON line (core.journal.prepare_for_write's PreparedWrite.line, parsed); jsonschema validates it only in tests, matching gate-record.json's own precedent (src/ never runtime-validates against it).

allOf.description: AD-28: intent_id is mandatory on every outcome entry and absent on every intent/observation entry.

id.description: The composite (writer_id, counter) id -- monotonic within a writer, never across the run (AD-28).

ts.description: Millisecond-precision UTC ISO-8601, 'T'/'Z' only, exactly 3 fractional digits -- one canonical spelling, since AD-28's total order (ts, writer_id, counter) string-compares ts directly and two legitimate spellings of the same instant would sort inconsistently. Deliberately stricter than gate-record.json's own timestamp pattern (see core.journal's module docstring) -- gate records are never string-sorted against each other.

run_id.description: The AD-25 run id this entry belongs to. The \S pattern rejects a whitespace-only value that minLength alone admits, matching build_entry's own .strip() check.

story.description: The canonicalized story key (AD-23/AD-38), e.g. "2.6" or "6.1a" -- omitted entirely when the entry carries no story.

kind.description: The entry's kind, as configured by its writer (e.g. a gate verdict, a story transition). The \S pattern rejects a whitespace-only value that minLength alone admits, matching build_entry's own .strip() check.

intent_id.description: The composite id of the intent entry this outcome closes (AD-28). Mandatory on every outcome, absent on every intent/observation -- see this document's own allOf.

payload.description: Command-specific payload, opaque to this schema -- payloads over 4 KiB are rewritten to {"sidecar_ref": "blobs/<writer_id>-<counter>.json"} by core.journal.prepare_for_write before this shape is ever serialized (AD-30).

entryId.description: The composite (writer_id, counter) id (AD-28) -- structured, never a delimited string.

writer_id.description: Unique per appending process (a supervisor, a CLI invocation). Filesystem-safe: it becomes part of a sidecar blob filename.

counter.description: Monotonic WITHIN this writer -- never across the run (AD-28).
